name: Button
description:
The Button component provides a visual indicator for a user to make an
action of sorts, commonly used in forms, menus, and popovers.

For a customizable Button, use the Button object to access the
individual primitives of the Button component or style props.

**NOTE**: This API is _slotless_ and is a single rendered layer abstraction.

parts.name: Icon
parts.description: An abstraction displaying an icon that is replaced by a Spinner when `pending` is set to true

props.name: children
props.description: The icon to render. It is replaced by a Spinner while the parent Button is `pending`.

props.name: ref
props.description: A ref to the Spinner wrapper rendered while the parent Button is `pending`.

props.name: pending
props.description: When true, replaces the `Button.Indicator` icon with a Spinner.

parts.name: El
parts.description: An abstraction for using the Provider and Button.Root together

props.name: pending
props.description: When true, replaces the `Button.Indicator` icon with a Spinner.

parts.name: IconButton
parts.description: An icon-only button styled by the `iconButton` recipe, labelled with `ariaLabel` (or "Copy to clipboard" with `clipboard`)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: The aria-label attribute for the icon button.

props.name: clipboard
props.description: If true, the icon button is used as a clipboard trigger. In this case, the aria-label defaults to "Copy to clipboard".

parts.name: SplitButton
parts.description: A primary action `<Button>` attached to an IconButton that opens a Menu of other actions; `pending` disables the action and shows a Spinner

props.name: pending
props.description: When true, replaces the `Button.Indicator` icon with a Spinner.

props.name: actionText
props.description: The text for the primary action button.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the SplitButton.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The root container of the Button component.

props.name: palette
props.description: PandaCSS recipe variant for palette.

props.name: usage
props.description: PandaCSS recipe variant for usage.

props.name: shape
props.description: PandaCSS recipe variant for shape.

props.name: size
props.description: PandaCSS recipe variant for size.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Strips Cerberus PandaCSS recipe classes while preserving behavior and WAI-ARIA attributes.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.
